positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:

• Automated database backup and AWS snapshots using Python

• Constructed error tracking for Quality Assurance team

projects.title: AlphaFitness Application
projects.description:
• Developed an Android fitness application; Allows users to create profiles and track workouts and fitness goals; Visualized workout and pedometer data in real time using Google Maps and MPAndroidChart; Calculated and generated weekly activity report containing various workout statistics
• Tools used: Java, Android Studio, MVC, Multithreading, SQLite Database, Google Maps, MPAndroidChart, GitHub

projects.title: Recipe Application
projects.description:
• Implemented an Android recipe application; Leveraged Firebase Database to allow users to create new recipes, browse existing recipes, check items on a grocery shopping list, and manage meal plans in real time
• Tools used: Java, Android Studio, MVC, Firebase Database, AndroidSwipeLayout API, GitHub
